note: Naming schemes for --names; each variables row carries its name under every scheme here. A new scheme is a new row here and a new key in every variables row.

schemes.description: the long names WeatherBench 2 and Google's ARCO ERA5 store use (temperature, 2m_temperature, ...)
ERA5's short names as CDS NetCDF files spell them (t, t2m, ...); the surface geopotential is z_surface because z is the level variable
